_comment: How a storefront order is marked once the yard system has invoiced it. Read by
CoreYard through STORE_ORDER_POLICY_FILE and applied by `bin/coreyard orders
There is deliberately no 'fulfillment' block here. Which shipping groups exist, what
their tags are, and who ships them all live in content/freight.json — the one file
that decides shipping — and CoreYard derives the fulfillment rules from it. Two copies
of that answer would be free to drift, and the drifting one decides whether a parcel
order gets closed before ShipStation has bought the label, which costs the buyer their
Adding a 'fulfillment' object here overrides the derivation, and the contract check
will then verify every group it names still exists in freight.json.
